subject: Absorb Wire Graph Query Queue Sync Control and Orchestrate into the mature coordination fabric

body.text:
Targeted owner convergence from the old named native estate; do not inventory the whole repo and do not create another supervisor.

Verified legacy seams:
- BonfyreQueue v3 is already WorkGraph-backed with claim tokens, leases, retries/backoff, dead-letter, cancellation, fan-out/fan-in, restart-resume. Preserve Queue as a public WorkGraph surface; do not create a separate coordination queue for mesh work.
- BonfyreGraph is a content-addressed Merkle-DAG artifact graph with atom/operator/realization lineage. Preserve its artifact-graph specialty; do not let its private SQLite become a universal semantic/evidence owner.
- BonfyreQuery can build DuckDB scan projections over JSON artifacts and has native layer queries. Treat DuckDB/scans as disposable query projections/materialized views with source digest/validity, never canonical truth.
- BonfyreSync contains direct curl PUT behavior. Preserve Sync identity but route any real remote mutation through the mature external-effect/authority/receipt boundary. Current Run8 external writes policy remains closed except authorized Git development; a Sync command must not bypass that with raw curl.
- BonfyreWire is a consent-based network observation surface but legacy --authorized/--dumb-device flags are self-asserted process inputs. Preserve Wire's domain specialty while binding actual authority to canonical Authority/Identity; a CLI boolean is not authority.
- BonfyreControl owns a separate control.db with routing/cost/latency/competition policies. Preserve Control as a query/policy compatibility surface but converge routing and decisions into existing ProviderGraph/WorkGraph/ConstraintIR/ResourceWeather owners.
- BonfyreOrchestrate is explicitly machine-only and asks a model for only a small booster delta over an existing deterministic plan, with policy-memory/state-memory modes and uplift gates. This is valuable: absorb it as a bounded candidate-delta/proposal generator under existing convergence, not a supervisor or authority.

Build/use/fix through current canonical owners. Prove at least one real mesh-derived WorkGraph obligation can be observed through Queue, inspected via Query projection, content-addressed through Graph/evidence, and receive an Orchestrate booster delta without duplicating ownership or bypassing effects/authority.
